title: Add ExcludeFromCodeCoverage attribute to generated code.
intent: Coverage tools no longer count code the MessagePack source generator emits.

functional.text: Every formatter class the source generator emits is decorated with ExcludeFromCodeCoverage.
The generated resolver class is decorated with ExcludeFromCodeCoverage.

nonFunctional.text: No setting is required to turn the behaviour on.
